text:
Ivy (partnerships): VoltGear says several on-prem customers show 0 entitlements for 2026-03-21 01:00-02:00 UTC after their nightly sync. They attached sample event ids and a small CSV.
WebhookBot: alert: marketplace_webhook_failure: partner=voltgear region=eu error_rate=3.1% window=01:00-02:00UTC
Noah (eng-partnerships): Quick look: our consumer acknowledged window is 5m; VoltGear's retries were clustered ~8-10m after initial delivery. Events hit our late-path which currently doesn't patch hourly entitlement aggregates.
Rina (billing): If we accept replays without metadata, invoices will mismatch. Need replay_id + billing.replay=true + ledger.note=backfill. Also want a short reconciliation CSV to attach to invoices.
Ben (infra): Low-risk fix: add per-partner ack_grace override to 900s behind flag and a small probe that pings partner sync endpoint every 3m to measure latency. Probe config example:
```
partner: voltgear
interval: 180s
endpoint: https://voltgear.example.com/sync/health
timeout: 4s
metrics: marketplace.partner_latency
```
Ivy (partnerships): VoltGear ok with low-QPS probe. They want the backfill id in the header when we replay.
Noah (eng-partnerships): I'll add feature flag `marketplace_ack_900s` with per-partner override and ensure replay jobs attach `billing.replay_id` and `ingest_path=marketplace`. Staging replay command:
`curl -X POST https://staging.redwood.ai/internal/replay -d '{"partner":"voltgear","events":["v4d5e6"],"dry_run":true}'`
Ben (infra): I'll add alert: if p50_latency > 2s or failure_rate > 0.5% for 10m, scale ingestion workers and page eng-oncall.
Rina (billing): Billing checklist: mark invoices touching replay window as provisional, exclude replayed rows from revenue until reconciled, notify customers if adjustment > $2 with reconciliation_report.csv.
Ivy (partnerships): Owners & ETA: Noah - PR for ack override + replay metadata (ETA 4h). Ben - probe + alert (ETA 6h). Rina - billing hold & report template (ETA EOD). I'll ask VoltGear for sign-off on targeted replay.
Noah (eng-partnerships): Opening PR now. Will run dry-run once VoltGear confirms.
WebhookBot: action: feature-flag marketplace_ack_900s created by noah at 2751234605
Ivy (partnerships): Proceeding with plan in 30m unless objections. Will post replay_id here when queued.
